M1_P1.implementation: Paired N2 GEMM with RF epilogues; independent batch attention occupies disjoint halves of the sixteen SMs. Batch1 K/V export waits for the corresponding batch0 head export, while attention computation still overlaps across the two SM groups. Decode WO/W2 use N16/K128/single GEMM to fill all SMs, backed by cold microbench improvement. All LN hoist gamma/beta into RF6/7 before row loop. Keep exported prompt K/V in RF3/RF5, use transposed RF key view and RF value view for both attention query tiles, removing HBM rereads without arithmetic changes. Algebraically regroup tanh GELU to six instructions (FP32 rounding changes only). Prompt W2 only uses M64/N16/K32 single: two M groups reduce duplicated B transfer, all sixteen SMs active. Prompt W1 weights remain in 32 workgroup RFs for all M rows; two workgroups per SM. Output copies are row-sharded before STEP.COMMIT.

M2_D1.implementation: Resident new KV in owner RF3; redundant softmax per history shard eliminates probability HBM round trip; owner partial retained in RF. Head-local score and partial WAIT dependencies replace global attention barriers. Same-SM dense preload dependencies; fused LayerNorm affine/variance and GELU half-shift arithmetic. Stable distributed online softmax combines four local maxima, denominators, and unnormalized contexts; no score HBM exchange.
